<Window x:Class="LessonApp.MainWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        Title="Greeter" Width="320" Height="200">
    <StackPanel Margin="16">
        <TextBox x:Name="NameBox"/>
        <Button x:Name="GreetButton" Content="Greet" Margin="0,8,0,0" Click="OnGreetClick"/>
        <TextBlock x:Name="GreetingText" Margin="0,8,0,0"/>
    </StackPanel>
</Window>

Challenge: volume_control.MainWindow.xaml:
<Window x:Class="LessonApp.MainWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        Title="Volume" Width="300" Height="170">
    <StackPanel Margin="16">
        <TextBlock x:Name="VolumeText" Text="{Binding Volume}" FontSize="28"/>
        <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,12,0,0">
            <Button x:Name="DownButton" Content="-" Width="60" Command="{Binding VolumeDownCommand}"/>
            <Button x:Name="UpButton" Content="+" Width="60" Margin="8,0,0,0" Command="{Binding VolumeUpCommand}"/>
        </StackPanel>
    </StackPanel>
</Window>
